name: recallai
description: RecallAI - AI Conversation Memory Assistant (local-first: Web Speech, Ollama, Qdrant, SQLite)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n qdrant,api,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run qdrant" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test:ui: npm --prefix client run build && node e2e/ui.e2e.mjs
